axes_source: Read from data/brands/sourcegraph.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #00CBEC and the canvas #0F111A; contrast from the ink #F5F6FA on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #00CBEC; density from its 8px spacing base; geometry from its radii 4, 8, 12, 16px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion from its stated durations 180ms; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #00CBEC reaches 9.64:1 on the canvas #0F111A, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
name: Sourcegraph
